answer: Each agent identity is registered in pulse, a state tree whose SGX quote is checked by a zero-knowledge attestation circuit and anchored by falcon in the onyx consensus contract. Forging an identity requires compromising enclave hardware or provisioning distinct attested silicon that produces valid quotes; registrations follow a quadratic bonding curve O(N^2), and failed proofs irreversibly slash collateral, making Sybil expansion economically superlinear.
